verdict.rationale: Omarchy's source appears to be publicly readable: there is a GitHub repository at github.com/basecamp/omarchy, community members describe reading the repo, and one cites a specific commit (9285b19). However, nothing in the evidence states the license or that it is an open-source license, so only the readability half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented open license terms (e.g., MIT/GPL), first-party docs pointing to the source repository.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
